status_history.reason: Draft created from SRC-003 design extraction; not yet verified with current HyperFrames rendering across three compositing modes.

title: Soft Aurora Workbench
summary: A quiet but high-density AI workbench where soft aurora video provides atmospheric depth and frosted glass panels carry the logic layer. File transformation and module assembly are the two primary causal scene grammars.
avoid_for: pure transparent overlay without background context

canvas.tone: quiet high-density AI workbench with atmospheric depth
canvas.background_policy: Soft aurora video provides atmospheric depth behind a dark blue-black mask; the glass workbench logic layer must remain dominant over the aurora.

palette.strategy: One deep field role plus cyan and soft purple as semantic signal roles; state colors remain confined to status indicators and never expand into primary accents.

roles.value_policy: dark blue-black mask at low chroma and lower contrast than any workbench element

roles.semantic: active workbench element or current causal step
roles.value_policy: one cyan or soft purple glass highlight at a time; never both simultaneously as equal accents

roles.semantic: status encoding for success, warning, or risk
roles.value_policy: green for pass, amber for warning, red for block; confined to gate and indicator elements only

roles.purpose: state the current step, result, or module name
roles.style_relation: largest and clearest voice on the workbench surface

roles.purpose: label files, modules, parameters, or metadata
roles.style_relation: smaller, embedded in glass panels, locally readable

roles.purpose: display paths, commands, format identifiers, or data values
roles.style_relation: monospace, subordinate to display and body, used only for technical identifiers

typography.local_fallback_policy: Select installed fonts by role; verify actual rendered glyph coverage for CJK and monospace before rendering.

visual_system.whitespace_policy: Reserve a clear empty region around the active workbench element; aurora fills the depth layer without crowding the logic surface.

focus_policy.rule: One workbench action owns each shot; supporting cards, labels, and the aurora field remain subordinate.

purposes: visualize multi-format input converging to structured output
express order emerging from input chaos
scene_grammar.composition: Place disordered input cards on one side and a single structured output on the other, connected through a visible conversion core; cards enter in sequence, the core processes them, and the output reveals only after the transformation completes.
required_semantics: a real transformation or conversion step
visibly distinct input and output states
a causal connection between input variety and output structure
forbidden_uses: decorative file icons without an actual conversion process
invented output formats or fake transformation claims
static before-and-after without a visible causal action

purposes: visualize module insertion and workflow formation
express how independent parts form a coherent system
scene_grammar.composition: Insert modules one at a time into a workspace; each arriving module lights up and snaps into its functional position; surrounding modules adjust without losing readability; the final assembly shows the complete workflow with each module's role visible.
required_semantics: real modules or capabilities with distinct functions
a visible and logical assembly order
a stable final arrangement where every module position is motivated
forbidden_uses: fake skill cards or invented modules for decoration
generic puzzle-piece or gear metaphors without real capabilities
static grid of identical cards with no assembly narrative

entries.semantic_trigger: The narration names a file conversion, format transformation, or input-to-output process.
entries.action: Input cards slide toward the conversion core, pause for the transform action, then the output card emerges on the result side with a visible state change.
entries.result_state: The output card remains readable as the conclusion; the input side shows completion without reclaiming focus.
entries.hold_policy: Reserve a content-dependent result hold without extending the SRT window.

entries.semantic_trigger: The narration introduces a new capability, module, or component that composes into a larger system.
entries.action: A module card inserts into the workspace from off-screen, lights up on arrival, and snaps into its functional position with surrounding modules adjusting their layout.
entries.result_state: The assembled modules form a readable workflow; each module position is stable and its role is legible.
entries.hold_policy: Reserve a content-dependent assembly hold without extending the SRT window.

entries.semantic_trigger: The narration describes a quality check, review decision, gate pass, or block condition.
entries.action: A gate or barrier animates open for approved items with a visible pass indicator, or closes with an unambiguous intercept for blocked items.
entries.result_state: The pass or block state is visually unambiguous; the gate remains in its final position as the conclusion.
entries.hold_policy: Reserve a content-dependent result hold without extending the SRT window.

global_rules: Derive all motion from deterministic local time.
Simplify the choreography when the fixed SRT window cannot contain the full action.
Every motion must express a causal step: slide, assemble, snap, open, close, or reveal.
Aurora ambient motion must not compete with the active workbench element.

modes.usage: Primary presentation with aurora depth field, dark mask, and glass workbench on an opaque background.
constraints: Do not add burned-in subtitles or BGM.
Aurora glow must not obscure workbench text.

modes.usage: Isolate glass cards, process flow lines, and gate elements with crisp edges; aurora glow and soft light must be moved to a separate black-background light layer.
constraints: Move all soft glow, blur, and semi-transparent aurora fragments to the black-background light layer.
Verify hard alpha edges show no premultiplication artifacts.

modes.usage: Aurora glow and soft light effects rendered on black background for external blend-mode compositing; this layer carries no opaque workbench content.
constraints: Do not relabel an opaque full-frame render as a light layer.
Black background must be true black with no unintended alpha or luma leakage.
verification_requirements: No workbench content leakage into light layer

hard_rules: Choose the scene from the sentence meaning before selecting a visual component.
Aurora glow must not compete with the workbench focus element.
One hero action owns each shot.
State colors must only encode status, never expand into primary accents.
do: Make the result state readable without relying on subtitles.
Use file transformation or module assembly as the causal backbone of each scene.
Keep supporting glass cards subordinate to the active workbench element.
Separate aurora atmospheric depth from glass workbench logic surface.
Use the safety gate only when the content has a real review, quality, or gate decision.
dont: Copy MarkItDown, ECC, or Claude Code branding, product names, or logos.
Use code rain or a terminal window as the default tech background.
Replace the file or module process with a generic AI orb or glowing sphere.
Stack identical glass cards without a causal file flow or assembly narrative.
Use state colors as decorative accents outside of status indicators.

adaptation_knobs.adaptation_goal: Shift the primary accent between cyan and soft purple without changing the scene grammar or material system.
constraints: Never use cyan and purple as equal-strength accents simultaneously.
A palette-only change does not create a new template.

adaptation_knobs.adaptation_goal: Adjust aurora visibility to match content tone while preserving workbench readability.
constraints: At maximum brightness, verify workbench text contrast still passes.
Never let aurora brightness exceed the active workbench element luminance.

adaptation_knobs.adaptation_goal: Match the number of simultaneous glass cards to explanation complexity while preserving one primary focus.
constraints: Never create fake cards or modules to fill a denser layout.
At density 4, verify every card has a motivated role and is individually readable.

adaptation_knobs.adaptation_goal: Select between file transformation and module assembly as the primary causal grammar for the current content segment.
constraints: Do not mix both grammars in a single shot.
A segment switch between modes requires a clear narrative justification.

adaptation_knobs.adaptation_goal: Adjust the speed and impact of card entries, assembly snaps, and gate actions to match the content energy level.
constraints: At intensity 3, verify every motion still completes within its SRT window.
Consecutive shots must vary motion intensity; never repeat the same intensity more than twice in a row.

signature_motifs.description: Multi-format input cards converge through a visible conversion core into a single structured output; the disorder-to-order transformation is the narrative backbone.
signature_combination: disordered input to structured output reveal

signature_motifs.description: Modules insert one at a time into a workspace, light up on arrival, and snap into functional position; the final assembly shows a complete workflow with each module role visible.
Role or skill cards cascade into view in sequence, each unlocking after the previous one, building a scaled capability landscape.
A quality gate or safety barrier animates open for approved items or closes with an unambiguous intercept for blocked items; the gate state is the visual conclusion.
signature_combination: open animation with clear result hold
state color confined to the gate element

exhausted_motifs.reason: A glowing AI sphere replaces the actual file or module process with an overused generic symbol.
Terminal or code rain as a default tech background substitutes decoration for the real causal process.
A spinning gear as a generic system icon replaces the actual module or workflow structure with an empty mechanical metaphor.
Background gradient drift with a bottom progress bar provides no semantic connection to the file or module process being explained.

conflicts_with.reason: Both templates use blue-black backgrounds with glass panels and light effects; deep-sea particles and aurora workbench atmospheres compete for the same background role and create visual ambiguity.
conflicts_with.resolution: Borrow at most one data structure or layout pattern from deep-current-hud; do not borrow its deep-water material, multi-layer particles, cyan HUD lines, or flow-dot motion.

conflicts_with.reason: Both templates use glass card systems; swapping only the palette would produce indistinguishable SaaS card layouts with no remaining template identity.
conflicts_with.resolution: Preserve distinct scene grammars: file-or-module causal flow for soft-aurora-workbench versus vertical data narrative for forbidden-red-gold; do not borrow the red-gold palette or Song typeface.

borrowable_patterns.description: A portable multi-input-to-single-output transformation layout without the aurora glass material signature.
conditions: The narration contains a real file or format transformation.
The borrowing template restyles every material and background element.

borrowable_patterns.description: A portable capability composition layout where modules insert and snap into position, without the aurora glass material signature.
conditions: The narration describes composing real capabilities or modules into a system.
The borrowing template restyles every material and background element.

stale_rules.original_claim: Loop a fixed 60-second aurora video clip to cover the full project duration regardless of actual content length.
stale_rules.isolation_reason: Media looping, local time alignment, caching behavior, and licensing must be verified against current HyperFrames media contracts before reuse.

stale_rules.original_claim: A fixed 154-second total duration with exactly two hard transitions structures every video using this template.
stale_rules.isolation_reason: Total duration and transition count are original project parameters tied to specific content length; they are not reusable design rules and must be derived from actual SRT timelines.

stale_rules.original_claim: Use 63 agents, 250 skills, and 79 commands as the default narrative scale data for module assembly scenes.
stale_rules.isolation_reason: These business metrics are specific to the original ECC project and cannot serve as default values; scale data must be derived from the actual content being explained.
